description: This file defines a Java class 'ByteBufferConverter' that provides utility methods to convert between ByteBuffer and byte array representations, and it is annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: ByteBufferConverter
classes.description: A Spring component providing utility methods for converting ByteBuffer to byte[] and vice versa.

methods.name: convert(ByteBuffer buffer)
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a byte array, preserving the buffer's position.

methods.name: convert(byte[] buffer)
methods.description: Wraps a byte array into a ByteBuffer.
